title: Kestrel Commercial Fleet Lease Terminal Rental Adjustment Calculation: The TRAC Deficiency Charge
content:
# Terminal Rental Adjustment Calculation Note — TRAC Deficiency Charge, Kestrel Commercial Fleet Lease

**The settlement read.** The sale settlement read is the unit's sale settlement with the latest settlement date; where two share that date, the one posted first is used. From it are taken the book value retired, the gross sale proceeds and the actual sale expenses.

**Calculation.** For a TRAC unit of the Kestrel Commercial Fleet Lease:

- The sale shortfall is the book value retired at the sale settlement less the net proceeds, never below zero.
- The net proceeds are the gross sale proceeds of the settlement less the sale expenses allowed less the deficiency remarketing fee.
- The sale expenses allowed are the actual sale expenses on the settlement, and the deficiency remarketing fee is the remarketing fee of the unit's program tier.
- The deficiency charge is the sale shortfall, rounded to the nearest cent.

**Order of figuring.** A schedule that replaces a standard figure applies first; any relief percentage then reduces the shortfall so figured; any credit is then subtracted, never taking the charge below zero; and the charge is rounded to the nearest cent once, at the end.

## Worked example (hypothetical inputs; tier remarketing fee taken as 360)

| Item | Working | Amount |
|---|---|---|
| Book value retired | from the settlement | 18000.00 |
| Gross sale proceeds | from the settlement | 16500.00 |
| Sale expenses allowed | actual expenses on the settlement | 700.00 |
| Deficiency remarketing fee | tier remarketing fee | 360.00 |
| Net proceeds | 16500.00 less 700.00 less 360.00 | 15440.00 |
| Sale shortfall | 18000.00 less 15440.00 | 2560.00 |
| Deficiency charge | rounded to the cent | 2560.00 |

Had the net proceeds been 18000.00 or more, the shortfall would be zero, never below zero.

## Points of judgement

- **Two settlements dated the same latest day?** The one posted first is read.
- **Whose remarketing fee?** The remarketing fee of the program tier of the unit's schedule.
